summary_1line: Sanjaya lists numerous kingdoms of the earth and explains the four Yugas and the declining lifespan and virtue of humanity across them.

image_candidates.scene_text: Kings of many realms clash on a vast battlefield, clawing over the personified Earth as if dogs fighting over a piece of meat.
Sanjaya stands before blind King Dhritarashtra in a royal hall, reciting the countless kingdoms spread across the world.
Four symbolic ages—Krita, Treta, Dwapara, and Kali—unfold in sequence, showing humans gradually shrinking in lifespan and virtue.
